title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot Workspaces updates for shared team work
summary: Hold: the Graph instructions omit a prerequisite that makes the operation fail when the setting appears in any group-level policy, although the briefing encourages administrators to check and configure groups. The roadmap facts and rename are supported; conflicting Microsoft storage guidance and an unsupported claim that the rename and new features arrive together also need correction.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The stated Microsoft 365 Apps admin center path reaches Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks.
claims.quote: Select Customization from the left pane. Select Policy Management. Create a new policy configuration or edit an existing one. From the Choose the scope dropdown list ... In Configure Settings ... Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/deployoffice/admincenter/overview-cloud-policy to sources: it identifies config.office.com as the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center. Keep the path; the cited notebook page gives its steps.

claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors can apply the microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks baseline once using mode applyOnce.
claims.quote:
POST /admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors
mode | monitorMode | The monitor mode. The possible values are: monitorOnly, applyOnce, unknownFutureValue. Optional; defaults to monitorOnly.
claims.fix: Keep the call and add to its note: 'Set mode to applyOnce and baseline resourceType to microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks, resourceVersion to 1, and properties.value to "0" to disable or "1" to enable.' The value property and allowed values are documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources.

claims.where: controls[0].scope; controls[0].api; Governance controls: Graph limitations
claims.claim: The Graph operation is presented alongside a group-scoped UI control with only a tenant-level-policy caveat and no warning that any group-level configuration makes it fail.
claims.quote: Before using TCM, ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and applyOnce fail for that resource.
claims.fix: Set controls[0].scope to 'other' and add to its note: 'UI: group or tenant. Graph: tenant-level policies only; ensure the target setting is not configured in any group-level policy in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center, or monitoring, snapshots, remediation and applyOnce fail.' Add that same prerequisite to the Graph limitations paragraph. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources.

claims.claim: AI Administrator is the least-privileged signed-in-user role for Copilot resource remediation and applyOnce.
claims.quote: AI Administrator is the least-privileged role for the signed-in user for remediation and applyOnce; don't assign that user-role requirement to the service principal.

claims.claim: The Graph route is a preview API.
claims.quote: This article lists the Copilot resource types supported in preview for monitoring and snapshots through the Tenant Configuration Management (TCM) APIs in Microsoft Graph beta.

claims.claim: Learn documents Pages and Notebooks in a user-owned SharePoint Embedded container shared with Loop My workspace.
claims.quote: Copilot Pages (.page files) and Copilot Notebooks are stored in the same user-owned SharePoint Embedded container used by Loop My workspace.
claims.fix: Add: 'Microsoft's storage overview differs: Pages and Notebooks are stored in OneDrive for Business; only those created before November 2025 remain in the user-owned SharePoint Embedded container.' Cite and add https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/loop/cpcn-storage to sources. Retain the existing admin-page account as the other side of this documentation discrepancy.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Learn says Pages and Notebooks storage counts toward the organisation's SharePoint quota.
claims.quote: Storage counts toward your organization's overall SharePoint quota.
claims.fix: Add to Cost and licensing: 'The storage overview differs: current Pages and Notebooks count against the user's OneDrive storage limit; only legacy items created before November 2025 count against the organisation's SharePoint quota.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/loop/cpcn-storage. Change 'SharePoint storage only' in the cost rationale to 'storage, with differing Microsoft guidance on the applicable quota'.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions

claims.claim: The storage architecture of newly shared Workspaces content is not specifically described.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes no autonomous action and no autonomous behaviour is documented for these updates.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Workspaces summaries data autonomous. Read roadmap and rename support article; they describe surfacing actions and collaboration, not autonomous execution. Search results about Cowork and other agents concern different features.

claims.claim: Users will see the rename and the new team features at the same time.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Workspaces Work IQ default state summaries; Copilot Workspaces summaries data autonomous. Read roadmap December/November targets and support late-October phased rollout; neither says the rename and all roadmap updates arrive simultaneously.
claims.fix: Replace 'Users will see a renamed product and new team features at the same time' with 'Users will see a renamed product, and the roadmap plans new team features'. Keep the separately verified links-and-redirect statement.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout and After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The checklist tells readers to allow WebSocket endpoints and review storage, but neither control has a table row.

The network and storage facts remain in their body sections; do not add unverified control rows.
